This tree is significant because it represents Israel's divine relationship with God and the covenant He has made with His people. Furthermore, the birch tree is associated with purification and renewal in Christian symbolism as it is one of the trees used in the production of aspen and willow wands used in the rituals of Ash Wednesday and Palm Sunday, among other occasions.
